takeaways.text: Advertising revenue grew 27% to $35.6B — 98 cents of every dollar Meta made — helped by 20% more ad views and a 6% higher average price per ad.
takeaways.title: Ads did the lifting

takeaways.text: Costs rose just 6% while revenue rose 27%, so operating margin widened to 38% from 25% a year ago and net income more than doubled to $12.4B — free cash flow was $12.5B.
takeaways.title: The efficiency year paid off

takeaways.text: Reality Labs lost $3.8B in the quarter on $440M of revenue — slightly less than the $4.0B it lost a year ago, but still the one big drag on an otherwise highly profitable company.
takeaways.title: Reality Labs still burns cash

verdict: Meta's revenue jumped 27% to $36.5B as ad impressions rose 20% and prices 6% — and with costs up only 6%, operating income nearly doubled to $13.8B and it kept $12.4B as profit, about 34 cents of every dollar.
